endpoints.name: Get Factory Complaint By ID
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve complete complaint details including commercial, factory visit, observation report, and credit note data
endpoints.short_description: Fetches full complaint details with associated commercial, factory visit, observation report, and credit note records
endpoints.detailed_description: Validates complaint ID > 0. Retrieves complaint header, details, factory visits, observation reports, credit notes. Maps to DTOs. Retrieves complaint files grouped by type (Image, PDF, Video). Returns nested structure with complaint details, dealer info, commercial details, factory visit details, observation report, credit notes, and files.

authentication.notes: Token extracted but token validation commented out in code; accessed via token extract

response.notes: Data object contains ComplaintDetails, DealerDetails, CommercialDetails, FactoryVisitDetails, ObservationReportDetails, CMSCreditNoteDetails, imageFiles, documentFiles, videoFiles

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieve comprehensive complaint record with all related entities
business_logic.preconditions: Complaint ID must exist; commercial header must exist; complaint details must exist
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: INFERRED FROM CODE: Retrieves user actions based on token

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: User needs to view complete complaint details with all related records
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: Listing complaints or creating new complaint

error_handling.not_found: 404 if complaint header or details not found
error_handling.unauthorized: No explicit check in this endpoint

endpoints.name: CreateFactory
endpoints.business_purpose: Create a new factory record with name, description, address, and phone number.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates new factory record. Validates factory name uniqueness. Creates audit log.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Factory name required and must be unique.

idempotency.notes: Name uniqueness check means repeated calls fail. Recommend idempotency key on client.

endpoints.name: UpdateFactory

business_logic.side_effects: Audit log created with old and new values.

idempotency.notes: Name uniqueness check per ID reduces risk. Audit log tracks changes.

endpoints.name: DeleteFactory

idempotency.notes: Repeated DELETE calls fail once deleted. Audit log needed for idempotency detection.

business_logic.validations: Token validation. selecteduserId > 0. User exists. At least one factory ID. Factories exist.

idempotency.notes: Deletes and recreates mappings. Multiple calls delete intermediate mappings.
